extracted.intended_audience: Wolfram Language / Mathematica users who want to create or apply notebook stylesheets
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for using the File > New > Styled Notebook command to open the Stylesheets palette, create new styled notebooks, or apply stylesheets to existing notebooks in the Wolfram notebook environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Styled Notebook menu item behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Styled Notebook opens the Stylesheets palette to create a styled notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Stylesheets palette is opened by the File > New > Styled Notebook menu item; it is the entry point for creating or applying notebook styles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylesheets palette functions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Stylesheets palette creates notebooks of a particular style or applies stylesheets to open notebooks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the palette either to generate a new notebook already using a chosen stylesheet or to apply a stylesheet to an already-open notebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creating a new notebook of a particular style
rubrics_metrics.description: To create a notebook of a particular style, select a stylesheet by moving your mouse over a thumbnail and clicking New.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hover the desired stylesheet thumbnail in the Stylesheets palette to reveal controls, then click New to create a new notebook that uses that stylesheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying a stylesheet to an existing notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: If you want to pick a stylesheet for an existing notebook, select that notebook to give it focus. Then apply the stylesheet by moving your mouse over a thumbnail and clicking Apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the target notebook window is focused/selected before applying a stylesheet from the Stylesheets palette; hover the thumbnail and click Apply to change the notebook's stylesheet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related tools and documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: See Also: Menu Items: Edit Stylesheet, Option Inspector. Related Guides: File Menu; Menu Items; Notebook Basics; Notebook Formatting & Styling; Document Generation; Stylesheets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to Edit Stylesheet and Option Inspector for editing styles or advanced options, and consult the listed related guides for broader context on notebook formatting and document generation.
